about_hero_description: We didn't just build another blocker. We built an engine for behavioral change. Ace Blocker is designed to break the cycle of internet addiction at the source.
about_mission_description: Internet addiction isn't about a lack of willpower; it's about systems designed to exploit your biology. We build tools that fight back, giving you the upper hand in the battle for your attention.
about_tech_description: Under the hood, Ace Blocker uses a high-performance, system-wide proxy engine that ensures nothing slips through the cracks.
about_feature_system_description: Unlike simple browser extensions, Ace Blocker operates at the network level. This means it protects your entire system—apps, games, and every browser you use.
about_feature_intel_description: Our engine handles millions of site rules in real-time using high-performance database technology, allowing for instant filtering without slowing down your connection.
about_feature_scripts_description: Blocking isn't always the answer. Resistance Mode makes addictive sites less appealing by dynamically adding friction to them, breaking the cycle at the source.
about_feature_locks_description: Set it and forget it. Lock your schedules to ensure that when your willpower dips, your protection remains absolute and tamper-proof.
about_cta_description: Join thousands of users who have transformed their relationship with the internet using Ace Blocker.

site_og_description: Ace Blocker is the most powerful blocker designed to help you overcome internet addictions through intelligent site filtering and behavior-shaping scripts.
home_description: Set the rule while your judgment is clear. Ace keeps it in force when changing your mind would be easiest.
home_decide_description: Choose what to block, when the rule applies, and how much resistance you want.
home_enforce_description: Schedules and network policies apply automatically without asking you to decide again.
home_hold_description: Lock a rule and the edit path stays closed until the commitment period ends.
home_resistance_title: Friction you can set, not merely toggle.
home_resistance_description: Resistance changes how tempting sites behave. Higher levels remove more of the cues that keep a session going.
home_schedule_description: Build a week once. Ace turns those hours into active enforcement, with locks where you need the decision to stay fixed.
home_packs_title: Block categories as policies, not chores.
home_packs_description: Site Packs group known destinations so a rule can cover a category without maintaining a domain list by hand.
home_privacy_note: Blocking decisions and statistics stay on your device. Ace does not need your browsing history to hold the line.
home_closing_title: Make the rule before you need it.
home_closing_description: Ace is free to download. Add Pro when you need broader packs, backup, and expanded resistance tools.
policy_lock_description: Editing stays unavailable until the boundary expires.
policy_attempt_denied: Change held. This policy stays in force until Monday at 08:00.
resistance_off_detail: No behavior changes. Blocking policies still apply where configured.
resistance_low_detail: Light friction removes a few high-reward cues while leaving the site mostly familiar.
resistance_medium_detail: More visual and interaction cues are removed so automatic scrolling takes more effort.
resistance_high_detail: Strong friction strips back the experience and interrupts the patterns that keep attention captured.
resistance_maximum_detail: Maximum friction makes supported sites deliberately plain and difficult to consume automatically.
footer_identity_line: A personal enforcement instrument for decisions you want to keep.
about_mechanism_description: Ace separates the moment you make a decision from the later moment when temptation asks you to reverse it.
about_policy_title: Policies carry intent into the future.
about_policy_description: Targets, schedules, resistance, and lock state live together as one enforcement object.
about_resistance_description: Blocking is not the only lever. Ace can make supported sites less rewarding before a session turns automatic.
about_schedule_title: Time is part of the rule.
about_schedule_description: Schedules are visible boundaries, not background automation. You can see when enforcement starts, ends, and stays locked.
about_packs_description: Curated categories let one policy cover a recognizable class of sites while keeping the rule understandable.
pricing_compare_title: One enforcement system. More capability with Pro.
pricing_compare_description: The free plan keeps the core blocker useful. Pro expands policy scope, resistance, and cloud features without changing the product.
